_comment: Second model family for the training-utility comparison: kanana-1.5-8b-instruct (Llama 3 architecture, Apache-2.0, non-gated) under the Qwen recipe on the two 2,202-row data conditions, scored on the v0.5.4 key. The base is the same checkpoint converted to GGUF and registered as kanana1.5:8b (training/register_kanana.sh). Legacy prompt layout, so the arms are comparable with the Qwen3-8B arms. Run with run_experiment.sh experiments/exp_kanana.json.
